brief: Mary Magdalene was one of a group of women from Galilee who were healed by Jesus and supported his cause. Mary is named in all the Gospels as being present at the crucifixion and as a prime witness to the resurrection. This is most movingly represented by John where Mary is the first person to witness to the risen Jesus in the words, “I have seen the Lord.” There is no basis for the traditional identification of Mary Magdalene with the sinful woman who anointed Jesus’ feet, nor with Mary of Bethany, the sister of Martha.
